n: Magic Spice Sapporo Honten (マジックスパイス 札幌本店)
address: Hongō-dōri 8-chōme Minami 6-2, Shiroishi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The shop that named 'soup curry' — a broth of about twenty spices built on the idea that food is medicine, ordered by escalating heat levels.

n: Okushiba Shōten Ekimae Sōseiji (奥芝商店 駅前創成寺)
address: Hokuren Bldg B1F, Kita 4-jō Nishi 1-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Soup curry rebuilt around a sweet, rich shrimp-head dashi, piled with Hokkaido vegetables — the chain's station-side temple-themed branch.

dish: thick, rich soup curry loaded with vegetables
n: Sapporo Rakkyo Kotoni (札幌らっきょ 琴似店)
address: Capitaine Kotoni 1F, Kotoni 1-jō 1-7-7, Nishi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Kotoni stalwart whose deep, concentrated broth is the one curry-heads graduate to.

dish: jingisukan of purebred Hokkaido Suffolk lamb
n: Jingisukan Hitsujikai no Mise Itadakimasu (羊飼いの店 いただきます。)
address: Minami 5-jō Nishi 5-1-6, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Susukino jingisukan run by an owner who took up shepherding to supply it — rare cuts of purebred Hokkaido Suffolk on the domed grill.

dish: charcoal jingisukan in a former members-only club (est. 1953)
n: Tsukisappu Jingisukan Club (ツキサップじんぎすかんクラブ)
w: Fresh mutton over charcoal in clay braziers, at a ranch-side club that began in 1953 as members-only.

n: Shibetsu Barbecue (士別バーベキュー)
address: Minami 3-jō Nishi 7-7, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Tanukikōji 7-chōme arcade grill counted among the city's best for rare Suffolk lamb from Shibetsu.
